# Basenames of pending D1 migrations that are approved to apply even when
# they contain DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, DROP INDEX, TRUNCATE, DELETE FROM
# without WHERE, or a table rebuild.
# One basename per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# Prefer this file. A pull request label opts in every pending destructive
# migration in that release, not a single file.
#
# A line here is the durable opt-in. The release also accepts either:
# - the pull request label migration-destructive-ok (approves every pending
#   destructive migration in that release), or
# - a merge-commit trailer, repeated per file:
#   Migration-Destructive-Ok: 0009_example.sql
#
# Do not list a migration until a human has reviewed the SQL. This file does
# not restore D1 and it does not edit an applied migration.
# 0008_account_provider_key.sql is a table rebuild. It is intentionally not
# listed. If it is still pending, add it here or use the label before release.
